title: Keyboard shortcuts
summary: Select, copy, paste, undo and save with Ctrl.

steps.say: Select everything: hold Ctrl, tap A.
steps.detail: A for All. Your words turn blue.

steps.say: Copy it: hold Ctrl, tap C.
steps.detail: C for Copy. Nothing seems to happen, but it is remembered.

steps.say: Paste it: hold Ctrl, tap V.
steps.detail: The copy appears. Now there are two lines.

steps.say: Undo it: hold Ctrl, tap Z.
steps.detail: Z is the undo button. It fixes mistakes.

steps.say: Save it: hold Ctrl, tap S.
steps.detail: The Save window opens, just like File, then Save.

steps.say: Click Cancel. We don't need to save this one.
steps.detail: Cancel closes a window without doing anything.
